observations: A thick black outline defines a large head in three-quarter profile against a flat warm-brown field; two horizontal zigzag bands in red and yellow extend left from the eye zone into the background.

The interior is packed with layered lines in green, teal, pink, red, and white forming looping and rectangular sub-zones; a spiral with a small star-like mark sits where the eye would be, and a red coiled shape marks the ear area.

A row of white arch shapes along the lower jaw reads as teeth; above it, bands of green parallel lines and teal curves fill the cheek and chin, while a pink outline traces a larger arc around the right side of the head.
reading: The flat brown field holds the head steady while everything inside it moves in a different direction. Zigzag bands cut across the eye line like a signal interrupting the form. Layered loops and rectangles fill the interior without settling into a single reading—mechanical, anatomical, and decorative at once. The spiral eye and arched teeth give the face its anchor points; the rest resists resolution.
